#!/bin/bash

# Post-receive hook for deploying main and dev branches

REPO_DIR=$(pwd)
MAIN_DEPLOY_DIR=/var/www/main
DEV_DEPLOY_DIR=/var/www/dev

# Read all refs that were pushed
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=$(echo $refname | sed 's|refs/heads/||')

    case $branch in
        main)
            # Deploy main branch
            mkdir -p "$MAIN_DEPLOY_DIR"
            rm -rf "$MAIN_DEPLOY_DIR"/*
            git --git-dir="$REPO_DIR" archive $newrev | tar -x -C "$MAIN_DEPLOY_DIR"
            echo "Deployed main branch to $MAIN_DEPLOY_DIR"
            ;;
        dev)
            # Deploy dev branch
            mkdir -p "$DEV_DEPLOY_DIR"
            rm -rf "$DEV_DEPLOY_DIR"/*
            git --git-dir="$REPO_DIR" archive $newrev | tar -x -C "$DEV_DEPLOY_DIR"
            echo "Deployed dev branch to $DEV_DEPLOY_DIR"
            ;;
    esac
done

exit 0
